fato_historico: 1924: The Georgian opposition stages the August Uprising against the Soviet Union.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to find your inner fortress, Taurus. Just as history shows that standing firm for your truth can ignite powerful transformation, you may feel a push to reclaim your personal sovereignty today. It is a good time to ground your intentions firmly in the earth and consider how your values guide your path forward through any current challenges.
frase_do_dia: Your persistence is a garden where your most beautiful dreams eventually bloom in light.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of abundance and internal strength in life.
conselho: Trust your steady pace; slow progress is still progress toward your ultimate goals.
